scope: Latest canonical English and full Vietnamese sidecars for lectures 01–05, all 20 sections. Translation/content parity review only; no fresh full visual slide audit.
result: No factual or semantic correctness blockers found in the reviewed main bodies.

checks.nullAnyAll: l2-4 correctly preserves TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN, WHERE retaining TRUE, decisive cases, empty ANY FALSE / ALL TRUE, and NOT EXISTS versus NOT IN with NULL.
checks.raDivisionClosureCodd: l3-2 through l3-4 correctly preserve attribute/schema validity, set versus bag projection and difference, inner-join rewrite restriction, safe/domain-independent Codd scope, candidate domain for empty-divisor division, and non-NULL set assumptions.
checks.hddUnits: l4-2 and l4-3 arithmetic checked: 7.1ms per random request, 1420ms random / 27ms continuous scan, approximately 52.6 ratio; 14.2ms versus 7.2ms for 2 pages; byte offsets 28672, 28792, 49152 and header-adjusted 49664. Vietnamese decimal commas retain meanings.
checks.bufferPolicies: l5-1 through l5-4 correctly preserve pin eligibility, independent dirty state, no forced eviction when all frames pinned, LRU last-unpin convention, 6 misses/2 hits, dirty write counted separately, CLOCK hand/ref/pin trace, MRU 5-miss trace and WAL restriction.
checks.ddlSourceNumber: Spot-checked private lecture02 extracted PDF page 8: printed slide 9 contains DDL/DML/DCL. The additional VI page-number sentence is correct.
checks.narrative: Vietnamese paragraphs are connected and explain causes, mechanisms and worked answers. Conversion of existing h3/aside/exercise structures into prose does not by itself create a correctness defect. Main teaching content is substantive, not only introductory labels.

findings.evidence: VI goal 1 says 'Phân biệt latency, bandwidth và locality', but the body explains latency/capacity/durability and spatial/temporal locality without defining bandwidth. Canonical EN goals instead include distinguishing bytes, pages and records, which the VI body does explain.
findings.recommendation: Use matching EN-goal translations, or explicitly define bandwidth and its relationship to transfer time in both languages. Matching the current EN goals is the smaller fix.

findings.evidence: Every href is preserved, but Vietnamese source labels only say the first PDF page of each link. For example l5-4's EN caption names physical pp. 22,27,28,29,30,31,32,33,34, while VI says only 'PDF trang 22'. l4-1 similarly reduces pp. 11–16 and 19–22 to 'PDF trang 11'. This makes the verified topical scope harder to inspect in VI, though the starting links are correct.
findings.recommendation: Restore the full canonical physical-page lists/ranges in translated captions. Keep PDF page numbers distinct from printed slide numbers, as l2-1 already does.

findings.evidence: The VI prose includes the underlying takeaway and worked-answer meanings, but removes most h3/aside and some original details blocks. This reduces scanning cues compared with EN; no lost essential technical content was found because those meanings remain in the paragraphs.
findings.recommendation: Optionally restore a few contextual subsection headings and translated takeaway callouts after the coherent explanations. Do not revert the body to bullet-only fragments. Treat this as presentation parity, not a factual blocker.

limitations: This review did not independently validate every slide diagram or metadata verification claim.
Quiz-bank questions, runtime translation selection, build and browser behavior are outside this review.
No main-content edits were made; only this review report was added.
